title: Travel vocabulary quiz
instructions: Read each question and choose the best answer.

questions.prompt: Which word matches this definition? “an official document that lets you travel to other countries”
questions.explanation: Example: Do not forget your passport at home.

questions.prompt: Which word matches this definition? “the bags and suitcases you take on a trip”
questions.explanation: Example: Our luggage was lost at the airport.

questions.prompt: Which word matches this definition? “a piece of paper or e-document that lets you travel”
questions.explanation: Example: I booked a ticket to Madrid.

questions.prompt: Which word matches this definition? “the act of leaving a place, especially on a journey”
questions.explanation: Example: The departure time is 7:30 a.m.

questions.prompt: Which word matches this definition? “a situation in which something happens later than planned”
questions.explanation: Example: There was a two-hour delay because of the storm.

questions.prompt: Which word matches this definition? “a detailed plan of a journey”
questions.explanation: Example: Our itinerary includes three cities.

questions.prompt: Which word matches this definition? “a place to stay, such as a hotel or hostel”
questions.explanation: Example: We found cheap accommodation near the beach.

questions.prompt: Which word matches this definition? “an object you buy to remember a place you visited”
questions.explanation: Example: I bought a small souvenir for my sister.
